```python
def extract_fragments(rows, width):
    fragments = []  # (row_index, start, length, values tuple)
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        values = row['values']; act = row['activation']
        # real prefix
        try: n = values.index(1514)
        except ValueError: n = len(values)
        if n == 0: continue
        S = sum(act[:n]); Q = sum(a*a for a in act[:n])
        # high: a > mean + std  <=> (a*n - S) > 0 and (a*n-S)^2 > n*Q - S*S
        M = n*Q - S*S
        high = []
        for a in act[:n]:
            T = a*n - S
            high.append(T > 0 and T*T > M)
        # runs
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            if high[i]:
                j = i
                while j < n and high[j]: j += 1
                runlen = j - i
                if runlen >= 2:
                    if runlen <= width:
                        fragments.append((ri, i, runlen))
                    else:
                        # max activation sum window of length width, earliest tie
                        sums = [sum(act[s:s+width]) for s in range(i, j-width+1)]
                        best = max(range(len(sums)), key=lambda k: (sums[k], -k))
                        # earliest on tie: choose max sum; ties earliest -> use max with key (sum, -k) or manual
                        s = i + best
                        fragments.append((ri, s, width))
                i = j
            else:
                i += 1
    return fragments
```
